description.en: One shared space for an investment team: a single record per company, every meeting, filed document and post-investment update linked to it, follow-ups with owners, and a weekly leadership digest — kept current by each person's own agent.
description.zh-CN: 投资团队的共享空间：一家公司一条项目记录，所有会议、资料和投后进展都关联到它，待跟进有负责人，管理层每周一份周报——由每个人自己的智能体随手维护。

agentPrompts: Turn this meeting transcript into minutes, key findings and follow-ups, and link it to the right project.
What did the team see this week, what did we find, and what needs following up?
Write this week's team digest for leadership.
